main.description: Get detailed information about a community. Authentication optional; viewer state will be included if authenticated.

community.description: Community identifier: a DID (did:plc:...), an atProto handle (c-gaming.coves.social or gaming.coves.social), a scoped identifier with or without the ! prefix (gaming@coves.social, comicstrips@lemmy.world), or a bare name for a community on this instance (gaming)

schema.description: Detailed community view with stats and viewer state
